name: custodian

attempts.result: Correct identity and grid. Back flank plate switches anatomical sides; sleep pose drifts.
Selected. Back plate corrected. Sleep retains slight head/key drift and only subtle desaturation.
Rejected. Extra edge specks and residual sleep drift; no improvement over attempt two.

publication: Appended storySprites.custodian; ran bun tools/sprites/build-story.mjs. Pipeline slices equal cells, hardens alpha, removes specks, snaps to locked palette, scales uniformly and anchors frames. No pixels drawn by code or hand.
defaults: Used leaftail height 68, four columns and approved outline/palette treatment. worldHeight 0.8 and animation rows/rates follow task exactly.
visualReview: Opened entire final sheet on green, all directions and actions beside leaftail at native size, and 3x nearest-neighbor sheet. One creature across every row, overall head/body size steady with small silhouette wobble. Key, brass ear, plate and tail ring readable. Back has no face; side faces right. No visible pale halo or floor shadow.
remainingDefects: Sleep head and key shift slightly between frames, beyond a pure torso breath.
Sleep is only subtly duller/dustier than awake fur.
Small frame-to-frame silhouette and facial-shape wobble, most visible in side idle and front walk.
Walk stride is restrained; front/back steps read less clearly than leaftail's.
Sleep keeps the forepaws visible rather than a completely closed stone-like curl.
